layouts.name: single-file
layouts.source: The upstream single files (circlestone-labs/Anima split_files/diffusion_models/*.safetensors, and Civitai fine-tunes): tools/export-recipes/anima/single_file.py KNOWN_PREFIXES (line 52) and _strip_prefix (lines 89-98), which require every key to carry the same one of the two prefixes. Markers: the first two keys diffusers 0.39.0 recognises Cosmos 2.0 by (CHECKPOINT_KEY_NAMES['cosmos-2.0'], diffusers/loaders/single_file_utils.py lines 146-150, without the prefix) and the text conditioner's embedding (CONDITIONER_PREFIX, single_file.py line 55).

components.source: tools/export-recipes/anima/single_file.py convert() lines 212-217: the keys under CONDITIONER_PREFIX 'llm_adapter.' (line 55) go to text_conditioner with that prefix removed and no rename. The 'model.' prefix: anima/export.py lines 445 and 471 load the text conditioner and wrap it in patch.AnimaConditioner, which holds it as self.model (patch.py line 307).

tools/export-recipes/anima/single_file.py convert() lines 218-221: every other key goes through diffusers 0.39.0 convert_cosmos_transformer_checkpoint_to_diffusers (diffusers/loaders/single_file_utils.py lines 3668-3778, the Cosmos 2.0 branch): the replacements are TRANSFORMER_KEYS_RENAME_DICT_COSMOS_2_0 (lines 3717-3741) in its order, each applied to every occurrence (str.replace, lines 3767-3768); the exclusions are TRANSFORMER_SPECIAL_KEYS_REMAP_COSMOS_2_0 (lines 3743-3752), a key containing one is removed after the renames (lines 3771-3776). The 'model.' prefix: anima/export.py lines 525, 541 and 600 load the transformer and wrap it in patch.AnimaDit / patch.AnimaDitTokens, which hold it as self.model (patch.py lines 375 and 475).

layouts.name: diffusers-transformer
layouts.source: The transformer file of the diffusers repository (circlestone-labs/Anima-Base-v1.0-Diffusers, BASE_REPO of tools/export-recipes/anima/single_file.py line 47; transformer/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors). Markers: keys of that file.

components.source: tools/export-recipes/anima/export.py line 525 loads the file with CosmosTransformer3DModel.from_pretrained(subfolder='transformer'), whose parameter names are the file's keys; lines 541 and 600 wrap it in patch.AnimaDit / patch.AnimaDitTokens, which hold it as self.model (patch.py lines 375 and 475).
